reproduced_before_fix: Four quarter-notch wheel messages leave the native viewport stationary
Owner drawing changes the caller's selected font and text color
Wheel input past the top edge invalidates the visible window despite no position change
coverage: Sub-notch and sub-pixel input, direction reversal, disabled/page/large-line-count preferences and DPI-scaled line height
Real Win32 expanded/collapsed layout, small viewport, keyboard focus visibility and edge invalidation
Button and combobox DC restoration in normal, selected, disabled and focus states
Tray hide, timer processing, restore and re-registration

architecture.view: Native controls, fonts, deferred layout, DPI and focus
architecture.view_paint: Palette, panels, owner drawing and GDI resource ownership
architecture.view_scroll: Wheel input to pixel displacement with a retained fractional remainder
removed: Per-control synchronous MoveWindow repaint during layout
Per-draw temporary brush and pen creation
Unconditional layout when scrolling is already clamped at an edge

local_validation.rust: Unchanged; existing workflow regression matrix will validate the commit

limitations: Local native validation uses MinGW; full MSVC product validation is performed by GitHub Actions
Screenshots show native test fixtures, not a connected television
Physical mixed-DPI monitor switching, TV interoperability, CPU/RSS, end-to-end latency and two-hour soak were not measured
